Feedback from Coaches and encouragement from head coach Mr Abhijeet Pane sir keeps us motivated to help my Son learn more swimming and encourage others too to learn Swimming. featured_reviews.name: Irfan Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I joined the swimming program at Michael Phelps Swimming India, Kohinoor Club Kurla, expecting a professional and hygienic environment, but unfortunately my experience was disappointing.

The biggest concern is cleanliness and hygiene. The washroom areas are not maintained properly and often feel unhygienic. The pool maintenance also needs serious improvement. Additionally, there is no proper shade or sun protection around the pool area, making it uncomfortable during peak daytime sessions.

Another issue is the lack of proper team management and professionalism among some staff members. There seems to be poor coordination between coaches, and arguments or conflicts happening in front of students create an uncomfortable environment. Some coaches also appear uninterested and non-cooperative during sessions, which affects the overall learning experience.

There were also occasions where staff members appeared to consume tobacco products before or during sessions, which created an unpleasant environment due to strong odor and felt highly unprofessional around students and parents.

Communication is another challenge due to language barriers, and overall the atmosphere feels poorly managed for a place that represents such a reputed name.

I hope the management takes these concerns seriously and improves the hygiene, professionalism, discipline, and overall experience for students and parents.

featured_reviews.name: Mohammad Asif Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: Had an amazing experience learning swimming with Coach Shubhankar Sir! 🏊‍♂️ His coaching style is super patient, motivating, and focused on technique. He pays attention to every detail and helps you overcome your fears in the water. Each session is fun, challenging, and confidence-boosting. Highly recommend him to anyone wanting to improve their swimming skills!

featured_reviews.name: Toufiq Sayed
featured_reviews.review_text:
I opted in for their swimming programme last year and had a good experience overall- very professional and friendly trainers.

However, I wish they'd structure the programme to start by teaching basic survival in water first, instead of directly starting with freestyle and other swimming techniques.

Because midway through the programme I started having neck pain which further led  to the discovery that I had a neck issue since birth but it was passive till my neck started getting engaged a lot as part of learning the swimming techniques.
So I had to stop before I could learn basic survival in water which was my primary goal of joining the programme.

featured_reviews.name: Gurvinder Pal Singh Kalra
featured_reviews.review_text:
Title: A Refreshing Oasis in the Heart of Mumbai

As a resident of Mahim, I've been frequenting the Mahatma Gandhi Swimming Pool for many years, and I've always been impressed by its facilities and the overall swimming experience it offers. While there's always room for improvement, I believe the pool deserves a solid 4-star rating, reflecting its strengths and acknowledging the areas where it could enhance its offerings.

Cleanliness and Maintenance:

The pool complex is generally well-maintained, with clean and hygienic pools, changing rooms, and shower areas. The staff regularly checks the water quality, ensuring it meets the necessary standards. While there have been instances of minor cleanliness issues, they've been promptly addressed by the staff.

Facilities and Amenities:

The pool complex boasts a variety of amenities catering to swimmers of all ages and skill levels. The main pool, an Olympic-sized one, is ideal for lap swimming and training. The separate diving pool is perfect for practicing dives and aquatic stunts. Additionally, there's a smaller pool for kids, providing a safe and fun environment for them to learn and enjoy the water.

Pool Staff and Safety:

The pool staff is generally helpful and attentive, ensuring the safety of swimmers at all times. Experienced lifeguards are stationed around the pools, keeping a watchful eye on everyone. The pool also has clear signage and safety guidelines in place to minimize the risk of accidents.

Overall Experience:

Mahatma Gandhi Swimming Pool is a great place to come for a refreshing swim, whether you're looking for a leisurely workout or a fun family outing. The pool's facilities are well-maintained, the staff is friendly and helpful, and the safety measures are commendable. While there's always room for improvement, the pool consistently delivers a positive swimming experience, earning it a solid 4-star rating.

Areas for Improvement:

Parking: The pool's parking facilities can be limited during peak hours, making it challenging to find a spot. Expanding the parking area or introducing valet parking services would be beneficial.

Shower Rooms: The shower rooms could be refurbished to provide a more modern and comfortable experience. Upgrading the fixtures and adding more shower cubicles would enhance the overall experience.

Food Options: While there are a few snack and beverage options available at the canteen it closes by 9 pm and expanding the food menu to include more substantial meals would cater to swimmers who spend longer hours at the pool.

Despite these areas for improvement, Mahatma Gandhi Swimming Pool remains a valuable asset to the Dadar community and a popular choice for both casual swimmers and fitness enthusiasts. Its dedication to cleanliness, safety, and providing a welcoming environment makes it a rewarding place to spend a day in the water.

featured_reviews.name: Nirav Gangar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited a few times here for dinners & lunches now and had an amazing experience both the times.

Below are the food items we have tried here -
1. Sweet corn soup - It was nice and sweet.
2. Burnt garlic soup - Loved the taste. Highly recommend having it if you like garlic and soups.
3. Lemon coriander soup - It was a nice soup. Can try.
4. Lotus Kurkure with schezwan sauce - You love having lotus stem roots then this is a must order for you. Right amount of crispy and tasty.
5. Waterchest nut in sambal sauce - Enjoyed this starter as well. Very well made and can order during the waterchest nut season.
6. Special stuff kulcha - It was nice and stuffed well. It became very filling just having 1 portion of the kulcha with the vegetables.
8. Veg. Makhmali - finely chopped mix vegetable sabzi in red gravy. Have visited the restaurant many times now and this is the one which I have loved the most and the taste has been the same always and never disappointed.
9. Lasuni Paneer - paneer pieces in yellow lasuni gravy.
10. Paneer veg Diwani masala - Nice mix vegetable medium chopped with paneer pieces in red gravy.
11. Orange mojito - It was very sweet so did not like it as we were expecting it to have a tangy flavour.
12. Ginger twist - It was flavourful and absolutely loved having it as I love ginger.
13. Masala chaas - It was very refreshing. Highly recommended.
14. Roti - In roties, we have tried many and would only say that you can order whichever you liked. You won’t go wrong. They have Garlic option in all the Indian breads so that is fantastic.

All in all it’s an amazing restaurant for North Indian food in Matunga area if you are a member or know someone who is.

featured_reviews.name: Vacationswithus
featured_reviews.review_text:
Michael Phelps Swimming at Dadar Club is a great place for both beginners and intermediate swimmers to learn and improve their skills. The coaching follows a structured program focusing on proper techniques like balance, breathing, and body positioning, which really helps in building confidence in water.

The trainers are professional, supportive, and ensure that each student gets proper guidance. The pool is generally well-maintained, and safety is given high priority during sessions. The environment is friendly and motivating, making it comfortable even for those who are initially scared of water.

One of the best things about this academy is its systematic teaching method, inspired by international standards, which helps learners progress step by step. However, at times the batches can feel slightly crowded, and schedule management could be improved.

Overall, it’s a good investment if you’re serious about learning swimming with proper technique and discipline.

featured_reviews.name: Mihir Kittur
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been learning swimming with Deepak Sir, and it has been a wonderful experience.

He is extremely patient and empathetic, which makes a big difference, especially when you’re re-learning or picking up swimming as an adult. What stands out is his deep, practical understanding of both swimming technique and how to teach it effectively. He breaks things down in a simple, intuitive way that helps you build confidence step by step.

He also customises his approach based on your age, comfort level, and ability, which makes every session feel personal and productive.

I genuinely look forward to each lesson, and I’ve seen steady improvement thanks to his guidance. I would highly recommend him to anyone looking to learn or improve their swimming.

featured_reviews.name: Vinod Dubey
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very nice club, has a lot of facilities.
It has a gym with all the equipments, a nice swimming pool, both for adults and kids (the depth of the adult pool is, however, only about 4-5 feet, could have been a little deeper), a table tennis court room, a squash court room, a room for carrom.
And after all these activities, if you feel a bit hungry, then worry no more, Dosti Acres Clubhouse has got a restaurant too (though I am not a fan of their food). The restaurant serves, both, vegetarian and non vegetarian food items.

Multiple defects but Dosti builder is keen to just loot money from residents as they know people have no option. Dosti builder also unapproachable and do not respond to any complaints.
